property_summary: After any successful call to fallback sending exactly 10 ether from any sender when block.timestamp > pastBlockTime, the reference contract sets pastBlockTime == block.timestamp + 1, while the mutant sometimes stores a strictly larger value (block.timestamp + 2), so the invariant pastBlockTime == block.timestamp + 1 holds for all inputs on the reference but is violated by the mutant for some inputs.
change_summary: Insert an extra increment of pastBlockTime after assignment, producing a different stored value.
